facts.business: Mapro Industries Limited is engaged in construction activities and real estate development, including identification and acquisition of land, planning, execution, marketing, and maintenance of projects, with construction work subcontracted to third-party vendors, and has recently entered into trading of iron, steel, and cement.

segments.name: Trading of Iron, Steel and Cement

guidance_or_targets.statement: Outlook remains stable for the current year. The company is looking at other avenues for business growth.

Stringent contract conditions including time-bound completion, penalty clauses, and risk of blacklisting
Ability to attract and retain skilled and technical staff
Impact of inflation on operating costs and staff costs
Increased competition from local and global players
